diffs.diff: header pin 3 (MISO): part says gnd, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: The model wires the SPI Pmod for I2C, where the MISO pin of the chip becomes the address-select input ASEL ('Alternate I2C Address Select for I2C (ASEL).'), and tying it to ground selects the default address used by the driver ('ASEL (pin) = 0, device address = 0x1D'); the second reading only listed the generic SPI function (io).

diffs.diff: header pin 4 (SCLK): part says gnd, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: In I2C mode the datasheet requires the SCLK/VSSIO pin to be grounded ('Connect to VSSIO for I2C (VSSIO).'), which is how the model (wired for I2C) treats Pmod pin 4; the second reading described the SPI use of the same pin (io).
